overview: The Medford Bicycle Advisory Commission discussed upcoming infrastructure projects, bike light and helmet distributions, and planning for Spring Bike to School Day. The commission also reviewed updates on Bluebikes expansion and commission member recruitment.

items.title: Remote Meeting Rules Update
items.summary: Denis MacDougall reported that the governor signed an extension allowing municipal boards to continue holding remote meetings.

items.title: Helmet Donation and Distribution Planning
items.summary: The commission discussed accepting 70 donated helmets from Project KidSafe, with Daniel Nuzzo-Mueller volunteering to coordinate distribution with the Recreation Department.

items.title: Mystic Valley Parkway Redevelopment Review
items.summary: Bruce Kulik and Emily O'Brien reported on an advisory meeting with developers regarding proposed residential redevelopment and bicycle access at the former KISS 108 site.

items.title: Minutes Approval and Staff Recognition
items.summary: The commission approved the prior meeting's minutes and voted to send a letter thanking departing city staff member Amy Ingalls.

items.title: Winthrop Street and Infrastructure Updates
items.summary: City intern Lily provided updates on Winthrop Street bike lane proposals, spring street painting schedules, Bluebikes expansion plans, and the city's bike plan draft.

items.title: Bike to School Day
items.summary: The commission planned ride caravans and outreach to local school principals for the upcoming Bike to School Day in May.

items.title: Bike Lights Program
items.summary: Ernie Meunier updated the commission on recent bike light distributions, new grant funding from Brookline Bank, and plans for a summer light distribution.

items.title: Commission Member Recruitment
items.summary: Emily O'Brien reviewed applicant resumes for open commission seats, and resident applicant Noam Reveni introduced himself.
